drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 76-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.53, creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 12, pao2 56, platelets 233, sodium 139, wbc 9.7; vitals dbp 76-82, heart_rate 83-85, map 94-97, o2_flow 0-40, resp_rate 26-32, sbp 125-129, spo2 87-94, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; High-flow nasal cannula 40 L/min, FiO2 0.6
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.73, hemoglobin 11.8, platelets 231, sodium 139, wbc 9.6; vitals dbp 78-81, heart_rate 83-86, map 94-98, o2_flow 40, resp_rate 20-26, sbp 125-131, spo2 93-95, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 76-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
